envelope.description: storyChangeSet attributes commits by the Story trailer

body.title: storyChangeSet attributes commits by the Story trailer
body.summary: Give storyChangeSet (src/workflow/runners/build/story-commits.ts:82-128) an optional storyKey: keep only non-merge commits whose message carries `Insrc-Story: <storyKey>` plus merge edits; return attribution 'story-trailer' | 'first-parent-range' and sharedWithExcluded (Story paths an excluded commit also changed); fall back to today's set when no commit carries the trailer or reading trailers fails; warn on untrailed commits whose subject names the Story's build format; update the module header's limits (octopus exception kept).
acceptanceChecks: Without storyKey the units and paths equal today's exactly.
With storyKey, another Story's interleaved commits contribute no unit; two standalone S001 Stories are told apart.
With no trailered commit, or when trailer reading fails, the result is today's with attribution 'first-parent-range'.
sharedWithExcluded lists the Story's paths an excluded commit also changed.
